item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "9d433c06ff5f2d107ae6026a7b2c84c46a12d40884377f2b345d9c233445b71e",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "The conjunction of spatial interval integrability at every time, temporal interval integrability of flux at every spatial point, and the integrated balance identity for every four real endpoints.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side already contains precisely the first three conditions on the right. The equivalence asserts that these imply the additional almost-everywhere derivative identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Projects the additive monoid structure from a commutative additive monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies underlying additive structure for scalar actions without adding assumptions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "Makes a commutative semiring an algebra over itself using the identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalars act on real coordinates by ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts scalar multiplication from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar action used to establish continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "Every listed condition must hold; the alternatives are not disjunctive.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed field structure and derives nontriviality of its norm from dense norm values.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar-field structure required for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Forgets the distributivity requirements of a distributive monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains the real scalar action in the construction of continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "DivisionSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real scalar arithmetic for the vector-space instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The integrated balance is equality of vectors, hence equality in every coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "Field.toSemifield",
      "meaning": "Retains a field's semiring, inverse, division, and associated operations as a semifield.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real scalar instances without changing their operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "Filter.Eventually",
      "meaning": "A predicate holds eventually in a filter when its truth set belongs to that filter.",
      "effect_on_target": "Applied to the almost-everywhere filter, it requires the derivative assertion outside a set of measure zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "The finite index type of natural numbers strictly less than its natural-number parameter.",
      "effect_on_target": "The state has coordinates indexed by 0 through m−1; when m=0 the coordinate type is empty.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates every element of Fin n using the finite range list.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides finiteness needed for the normed finite product of real coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation from a heterogeneous subtraction instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "Here every subtraction is between vectors of the same type.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "HasDerivAt",
      "meaning": "Asserts a derivative with specified value at a point, using the neighborhood of that point and a fixed base point in the derivative filter.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires the ordinary full real derivative of the spatial integral as a vector-valued function of time, not a one-sided derivative or merely a formal derivative value.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, comprising implication in both directions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Equates the three-condition balance property with those same conditions together with almost-everywhere differentiability of every spatial integral.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed scalar-space structure from an inner-product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real normed-space structure on each coordinate; no inner products appear in the asserted identities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "A function is integrable on both (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the given measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires integrability between either ordering of finite endpoints. For equal endpoints both required sets are empty.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "IsModuleTopology.toContinuousSMul",
      "meaning": "A module topology ensures continuity of scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies a structural continuity instance for the derivative predicate, not continuity of q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring",
      "meaning": "A topological ring also satisfies the continuity requirements of a topological semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports continuity of real scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsModuleTopology",
      "meaning": "A topological semiring has the module topology when viewed as a module over itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Contributes the real-coordinate topology instance used for differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure",
      "meaning": "The type of measures on a type equipped with a measurable-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the measure object used consistently for integrability, integration, and almost-everywhere assertions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a measure on a set through its underlying outer measure, with values in the extended nonnegative reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows exceptional sets to be assigned measure zero even without an explicit measurability hypothesis on those sets.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.Measure.instOuterMeasureClass",
      "meaning": "Measures satisfy the outer-measure interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the almost-everywhere filter construction to use the real volume measure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.toMeasurableSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the measurable-space structure of a measure space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the measurable structure accompanying real volume.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure of a measure-space instance.",
      "effect_on_target": "All measure-dependent assertions use the distinguished measure of Real.measureSpace.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.ae",
      "meaning": "Constructs the filter of sets whose complements have measure zero, using the null-set predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "For each fixed a and b, the derivative identity may fail on a time set of measure zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action of a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves ordinary real scalar multiplication on coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the associative multiplication structure of a monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar semigroup structure used by scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the multiplicative monoid structure from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains real multiplication and its unit for scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts a semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the underlying scalar action without introducing any new condition on the functions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension is any finite nonnegative integer; positivity is not assumed.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains nonunital commutative ring operations while dropping the associativity requirement from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an underlying real ring structure in the topology instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital nonassociative ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological-ring instance without modifying real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the commutative additive monoid from the semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero for real-coordinate modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the underlying nonunital commutative ring of a normed commutative ring without a specified unit.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real algebraic structure needed for the topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital seminormed ring structure, forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real norm and arithmetic used for coordinate normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive normed structure underlying real-coordinate scalar spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "NonUnitalSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital nonassociative semiring interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the inherited real additive structure used in modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed field from a nontrivially normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Uses the same real field and norm throughout derivative and scalar-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and compatible metric while forgetting the commutativity requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the coordinate normed-group structure needed to construct integrability instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Provides the extended nonnegative norm and additive monoid structure inherited from a normed additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes vector integrability depend on the vector norm and the requisite measurable behavior.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed commutative ring's norm, metric, and ring operations without its unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real topological algebra instances with unchanged operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, ring operations, and compatible pseudometric of a normed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the seminormed real structures used by vector-space and topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "NormedField.toField",
      "meaning": "Extracts the field operations and laws from a normed field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real arithmetic for scalar-module structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "NormedField.toNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains a normed field's norm, commutative ring, and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real normed-ring structure in the scalar topology chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies scalar multiplication used in the vector-valued derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "Equips a function space with the pointwise module structure inherited from its codomain.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalars multiply each of the m coordinates separately.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Equips dependent functions with coordinatewise commutative additive-group operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vectors form an additive commutative group under pointwise operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Pi.instSub",
      "meaning": "Defines function subtraction by (f−g)(i)=f(i)−g(i).",
      "effect_on_target": "Both the difference of spatial integrals and the boundary flux difference are coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Builds a finite product normed additive commutative group using the norm and pseudometric of Pi.seminormedAddGroup.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the finite-dimensional vector norm and metric required for vector integration; the inherited norm's formula is not expanded here.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Builds the normed additive-group structure of a finite product from its component structures.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the vector norm used by the interval-integrability predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "Equips a finite product of normed spaces with a pointwise module structure compatible with its product norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin m → Real a normed real vector space for the integrals and LocalDef001.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology, constructed from the topologies induced by all coordinate evaluations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector-valued differentiation and integrability use the finite product of the real coordinate topologies.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the usual real distance to the topology used in the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Gives an RCLike field a real inner-product-space structure using its real inner product and underlying normed real algebra.",
      "effect_on_target": "At Real, supplies the coordinate normed real-space structure; it introduces no complex-valued coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real-number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both independent variables, all interval endpoints, and all vector coordinates are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real normed field together with the dense-norm-value property.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the nontrivial norm required for real differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Real.instAdd",
      "meaning": "The real addition operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Used in the real scalar topology and inherited vector arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "An inferred commutative additive-group structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive group on each coordinate and hence on the vector space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "An inferred commutative semiring structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the identity real algebra used for scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "Treats Real as an RCLike field with real part the identity, imaginary part zero, distinguished imaginary element zero, and its real normed-field and completeness structures.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real-coordinate inner-product and normed-space instances without extending the scalar or state domains to complex numbers.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Real.instRing",
      "meaning": "An inferred ring structure on the real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real addition and multiplication for the module instance chain.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "Real.instSub",
      "meaning": "Defines real subtraction as addition of the negative.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes each coordinate of the boundary term as flux(q(a,t)) minus flux(q(b,t)), in that order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "An inferred distinguished measure-space structure on Real; the supplied body does not expose the selected instance or its measure normalization.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the measure for every integral and almost-everywhere clause. Its identification with normalized Lebesgue measure cannot be independently checked from this body.",
      "status": "unclear"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive group equipped with Real.norm and Real.metricSpace.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the normed additive structure of each vector coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Combines the real normed additive group and real commutative ring, retaining their norm, metric, and arithmetic.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the real arithmetic and normed-space structures used throughout are compatible.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "Combines the real normed additive group with real field operations and multiplicativity of the norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar normed field for integration and differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric with distance |x−y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coordinate topologies and time neighborhoods are the ordinary real metric topologies.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "An inferred semiring structure on Real.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real scalar algebra for the topology instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Ring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the semiring structure of a ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Retains real scalar arithmetic while supplying weaker required interfaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Semifield.toDivisionSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains semiring operations, inverse, division, and related laws from a semifield as a division semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real scalar semiring instance without altering operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar-action operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real coordinate scalar multiplication to its continuity instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the seminorm, pseudometric, and commutative ring operations without the unit requirement.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the inherited real seminormed additive structure for normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the seminormed ring structure from a seminormed commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides a route to the real scalar pseudometric.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the compatible pseudometric of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar topology used for continuous scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Retains a semiring's associative multiplication, unit, powers, and absorbing zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative structure underlying scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonUnitalSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the real additive-monoid instances used by the vector-space structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology carried by a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the ordinary real topology and hence the coordinate product topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "instContinuousSMulForall",
      "meaning": "Coordinatewise continuous scalar multiplication induces continuous scalar multiplication on a product of spaces.",
      "effect_on_target": "Establishes the structural continuity requirement for differentiation into Fin m → Real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses a type's subtraction operation as heterogeneous subtraction with identical input and output types.",
      "effect_on_target": "Routes displayed subtraction to ordinary pointwise vector subtraction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "instIsTopologicalRingReal",
      "meaning": "Real arithmetic satisfies the continuity requirements of a topological ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports continuous real scalar multiplication; it places no regularity assumption on q or flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The oriented integral from a to b is the vector integral over (a,b] minus the vector integral over (b,a], with the given measure restricted to each set.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes orientation and signs in both spatial and temporal integrals; reversing endpoints negates the integral and equal endpoints give zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts subtraction and negation structure from an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies subtraction in the generic normed-space definition of LocalDef001.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A commutative additive group equipped with a norm and compatible metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "The generic balance definition and vector integrals require this structure, instantiated here on the finite real product.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, commutative additive group, and compatible pseudometric of a normed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the structure expected by the generic normed real-space parameter of LocalDef001.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group from a normed additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies underlying subtraction and negation for generic vector differences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
